1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Imparakazi yo mu gitondo.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

2.text: Mana yanjye, Mana yanjye,Ni iki kikundekesheje,Ukaba kure ntuntabare,Kure y'amagambo yo kuniha kwanjye?

3.text: Mana yanjye ntakira ku manywa ntunsubize,Ntakira na nijoro simpore.

4.text: Ariko uri uwera,Intebe yawe igoswe n'ishimwe ry'Abisirayeli.

7.text: Ariko jyeweho ndi umunyorogoto sindi umuntu,Ndi ruvumwa mu bantu nsuzugurwa na bose.

8.text: Abandeba bose baranseka bakanshinyagurira,Barampema bakanzunguriza imitwe bati

10.text: Ariko ni wowe wamvukishije,Wanyiringirishaga nkiri ku ibere rya mama.

11.text: Ni wowe naragijwe uhereye mu ivuka ryanjye,Uri Imana yanjye uhereye igihe naviriye mu nda ya mama.

12.text: Ntumbe kure kuko amakuba ari bugufi,Kandi ari nta mutabazi.

13.text: Amapfizi menshi arangose,Amapfizi y'i Bashani y'amanyambaraga aranzengutse.

15.text: Nsutswe nk'amazi,Amagufwa yanjye yose arakutse.Umutima wanjye umeze nk'ibimamara,Uyagiye mu mara yanjye.

16.text: Intege zanjye zumye nk'urujyo,Ururimi rwanjye rufatanye n'uruhekenyero.Kandi unshyize mu mukungugu w'urupfu,

17.text: Kuko imbwa zingose,Umutwe w'abanyabyaha untaye hagati,Bantoboye ibiganza n'ibirenge.

18.text: Mbasha kubara amagufwa yanjye yose,Bandeba bankanuriye amaso.

20.text: Ariko Uwiteka ntumbe kure,Ni wowe muvunyi wanjye tebuka untabare.

21.text: Kiza ubugingo bwanjye inkota,Icyo mfite rukumbi ugikize ubutware bw'imbwa.

22.text: Nkiza akanwa k'intare,Waranshubije unkura mu mahembe y'imbogo.

23.text: Nzabwira bene Data izina ryawe,Nzagushimira hagati y'iteraniro.

24.text: Abubaha Uwiteka mumushime,Mwa rubyaro rwa Yakobo rwose mwe, mumuhimbaze,Mwa rubyaro rwa Isirayeli rwose mwe, mumutinye,

25.text: Kuko atasuzuguye umubabaro w'ubabazwa,Habe no kuwuzinukwa,Kandi ntamuhishe mu maso he,Ahubwo yaramutakiye aramwumvira.

26.text: Kuri wowe ni ho gushima kwanjye guturuka,Ngushimira mu iteraniro ryinshi,Nzaguhigurira umuhigo wanjye mu maso y'abakubaha.

27.text: Abanyamubabaro bazarya bahage,Abashaka Uwiteka bazamushima,Imitima yanyu irame iteka ryose.

28.text: Abo ku mpera yose y'isi bazibuka bahindukirire Uwiteka,Amoko yose yo mu mahanga azasengera imbere yawe.

29.text: Kuko ubwami ari ubw'Uwiteka,Kandi ari we mutegetsi w'amahanga.

30.text: Abakomeye bo mu isi bose bazarya baramye,Kandi abamanuka bajya mu mukungugu bazunama imbere ye,Umuntu wese utabasha gukiza ubugingo bwe gupfa.

31.text: Abuzukuruza bazamukorera,Ubuvivi buzabaho buzabwirwa iby'Umwami Imana.

32.text: Bazaza babwire abantu bazavuka,Gukiranuka kwe ko ari we wabikoze.
